calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-08-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Marta Vallejo, CSR: Patricia J. VanSteenberge

Petitioner: Shau Lai Fong present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
Ms. Fong's son John Fong acted as Cantonese Interpreter.

It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: SHIRLEY CHAU FONG.

Decree signed in open court.
